articles.summary: Nextpower™ (Nasdaq: NXT), a leading provider of clean power technology solutions, today announced that the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office has issued U.S. Patent No. 12,803,495 for technology used in its NX Horizon-XTR™ terrain-following solar tracker. The patent includes a tracker with a torque tube design that follows changes in terrain elevation, helping solar developers build on more challenging sites with less grading and earthworks. Nextpower Awarded New U.S. Patent for NX Horizon-XTR Terrain-following Technology Nextpower’s pioneering terrain-following tracker has been deployed on projects representing dozens of gigawatts across multiple continents since its launch. Most utility-scale solar sites are not flat. Conventional tracker designs often require extensive grading to maintain a consistent tracker profile. articles.summary: Company announced updated 2030 financial targets of revenue of more than $7.5 billion and adjusted EBITDA of $1.6 billion, reflecting accelerated growth across its expanded platform Nextpower™ (Nasdaq: NXT), a leading provider of clean power generation and energy storage solutions, today updated its 2030 financial outlook at its Capital Markets Day, reflecting the expansion of its product portfolio and accelerated execution of its strategy. Nextpower is now targeting more than $7.5 billion in revenue, more than $1.6 billion in adjusted EBITDA, and adjusted earnings per share (EPS) of more than $8.00 by FY30. The updated FY30 revenue target is approximately 45% higher than the $5.2 billion target presented at last year’s Capital Markets Day (November 2025). The increase reflects the expansion of Nextpower’s platform and growth opportunities across its existing markets. Power collection and conversion and energy storage are each expected to become billion-dollar businesses by FY30.
